notes.title: TPOT Patch 1.0.4
notes.content:
Hello fellow Tersians!

We've just released our next patch.

TPOT Patch 1.0.4 consists of..
[list]
[*] Quality of Life and fixes for Flute Puzzle.
[*] Dark Red Reed is now a Light Violet Colour.
[*] The music in the background of the Flute Puzzle has been toned down for clearer hearing.
[*] The Reeds will now make the pitch sound effect when the player interacts with them.
[/list]

Thank you everyone for your continued support.
We hope you're enjoying Tersa as much as us!

-Madorium

notes.title: TPOT Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hello fellow Tersians!

We've just put out our first patch for TPOT:ACP.

Thank you to everyone for the feedback!
And we apologise for bugs found.

[b]TPOT Patch 1.0.1 consists of..[/b]
[list]
[*] Quality of Life fixes for flute puzzle.
[*] Quality of Life fixes in the Forest.
[*] Fix for flute puzzle that caused the cursor to go invisible and lock users out of game.
[*] Fixed a number of instances where Cynthia or Tippo would face incorrect direction in conversations.
[*] Fixed scenario that would cause Vegetender conversations to lock users in the conversation.
[*] Added version number to settings in main menu.
[*] Hotfix to fix unworking Steam Achievements.
[/list]

We hope you all continue to enjoy Tersa.

-Madorium

notes.title: PC Demo Version 0.2.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We have pushed a small but mighty update to our demo this morning. Here are the patch notes:

- The Puppet of Tersa demo is now playable on 32-bit Windows systems!
- Our inventory control system has been reworked. Previously items would be drag and drop to combine/use, you can now left-click once to select and left-click again to combine/use. Right-click allows you to examine the item.
- A few text updates are live (namely some interactions have been altered/added in)
- Bucket puzzle has been updated 


Thank you so much for giving our demo a play, we hope you enjoy it!

Don't forget to connect with us here on Steam, [url=http://www.twitter.com/puppetoftersa]Twitter[/url], [url=http://www.facebook.com/puppetoftersa]Facebook[/url], [url=http://www.instagram.com/madorium]Instagram[/url], [url=http://www.reddit.com/r/thepuppetoftersa]Reddit[/url], or [url=https://discord.gg/4Fuja4N]Discord[/url]!
